A0.authorization_scope: Verification ablation on development data (research/VERIFICATION_DEV_PROTOCOL.md): six arms per task (A0 Aljure text-answer-v2; A1 A0 + structured_labels + uncertainty_audit; A2 Aljure with text answers off; A3 A1 + targeted_review; P0 native Prime; P1 Prime + the same verification contract as a prompt) on 20 comparison and count questions from unused development windows at 8K and 32K, a seeded 20% repeated. Sonnet 5.5 through the Claude subscription; $4.93 per arm (one reservation plus a $0.60 allowance); known spend refused past $12. Expected about $6. Requires the owner's approval of this exact plan hash. Development evidence; no held-out claim.
